sentences.text: The Petitioner is a life convict in FIR No. 248/2010, registered at P.S. Dhaula Kuan, under Sections 506/365/376(2)(g) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 25/27/54/59 of the Arms Act, 1959.
By way of the present petition, he seeks grant of parole for a period of sixty days.
2. The Petitioner had submitted an application for parole to the Respondents, which remained undecided, thereby constraining him to approach this Court.

3. The State has now accepted the Petitioner's request and, vide order dated 22nd December, 2025,
directed his release on parole.
Copy of the said order has been supplied to counsel for the Petitioner.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 23/12/2025 at 21:03:59 4.

In view of the above, no further directions are required to be passed.
5.
Accordingly, the present petition is disposed of.
